HostCta.bubble: Are you a host? Free courts, rotation & game counts
HostCta.aria: Go to the host console and start your own badminton group (free)
HostCta.sheetDesc: The host console is a separate site — completely free. Copy the URL first (send it to yourself) so you can find your way back next time!
HostCta.copyHint: Save it somewhere — this URL is how you get back to the host console
HostCta.installTitle: Installable as an app — one tap from your home screen
HostCta.installAndroid: Android: open in Chrome → "⋮" menu → "Add to Home screen / Install app"
HostCta.installIos: iPhone: must open in Safari → tap the Share button → "Add to Home Screen"
HostCta.installInApp: ※ Inside LINE / FB, tap "Open in browser" first — in-app browsers can't install
